items.title: Five-minute breathing task
items.description: Take five quiet minutes for slow, comfortable breathing. Stop if you feel unwell.

items.title: Light walking task
items.description: Complete a short, comfortable walk when your surroundings and mobility allow it.

items.title: Wind down before 23:00
items.description: Aim to finish your wind-down routine and go to bed before 23:00 today.

items.title: Alcohol-free day
items.description: Follow your self-selected alcohol-free wellness goal for today. This is not suitable for managing alcohol dependence or withdrawal.

items.title: Complete your approved nutrition plan
items.description: Track the nutrition or vitamin step already recorded in your verified plan. No dose is generated here.

items.title: Prepare a quieter sleep environment
items.description: Reduce avoidable light and noise as part of your usual sleep routine.

items.title: Take a recovery pause
items.description: Consider a short, low-effort rest period and reassess how you feel.

items.title: Improve the next measurement
items.description: Adjust device contact, stay still, and retry when convenient.

items.title: Compatible measurement hardware
items.description: Review approved hardware options that may improve measurement coverage.
